description: NIST_CTR_DRBG follows implementation based on NIST SP 800-90 CTR_DRBG (Random Number Generator) March 2007 Section 10.2.1 and produces deterministic random bits. This is configured to AES 128 bits with Derivation Function based on Section 10.4.2.
